name: nostalgia
description: Pleasant memories of the past along with a sense of sadness that you can no longer directly experience that world. Often the memories are centered on other people and how you felt better at that time in some way.
perceptions: There was a time in the past when you felt better in some way than you do now.

comparisons.description: Nostalgia is a special case of wistfulness where the unattainable experience is about a time in the past where you have pleasant memories.

variations.name: cohort bonding
variations.description: Nostalgia can be a generational group bond with others who share the memories.
perceptions: There was a time in the past when you felt better in some way than you do now.
Other people of your age shared some of the same experiences.
Talking to those people might help partially re-experiencing the good times.

commentaries.quote: Nostalgic memories are sometimes idealized, benefiting from having left behind the anxieties of that moment.
It is sadder to find the past again and find it inadequate to the present than it is to have it elude you and remain forever a harmonious conception of memory.
